span.p:
🗺️ GoogleKarnatakaMap
· Full-screen Google Map
· Collapsible sidebar w/ place list
· Search + Geocoding
· Marker clustering (zoom < 9)
· District GeoJSON overlay
· Heatmap / Traffic / Transit / Bicycling
· Street View modal
· Elevation fetch
· Directions (DRIVING/WALKING/BICYCLING)
· Auth modal (localStorage)
· Reviews system
· Favorites + Collections
· Submit new place + Admin panel

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📸 ImageSlider
· Auto-advance carousel (4s)
· Touch swipe + keyboard nav
· Fullscreen lightbox
· Gap between auto/manual
· Lazy loading all images

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🏪 NearbyPlaces
· 3 tabs: Eateries/Hotels/Stays
· 5km Places API search
· Star rating + open/closed
· Error: API blocked / no results

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📄 karnataka-locations.ts
23 static locations
{ id, name, lat, lng, category,
description, images, metadata }
